That's the lowest level of support since 1995.Last year, more than 160 countries backed the proposal. Germany, Italy and Latvia abstained for the first time in 34 years.Several countries, including Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Morocco, Slovenia and Bosnia, voted against the resolution, many for the first time.The resolution, while not legally binding, is seen as a reflection of international opinion. It calls for the lifting of the economic, trade and financial embargo against the island.Renewed US pressure campaign against CubaThe US embargo dates back to 1960, after Fidel Castro’s revolution and the nationalisation of US-owned property. Now, as Russia expands its attacks on the capital, Kyiv has increasingly become a front-line city. With too few shelters for the 4 million residents of Kyiv , subway stations double as makeshift dormitories. Starting at about 10 every night, people create sleeping areas with mattresses and small tents. Children snuggle up to adults; pets seek comfort from their owners or find a spot among strangers between the cold walls. "We're alive," Halyna told DW, holding her 5-year-old son, Roman, close.
